claims.statement: In the O0 state with E=e3(s(B)^2)>=1/256, if the effective-dimension-three ridge kernel has at least three physical rows of leverage at least 3/4, then the full ambient quadratic form has a continuous density with essential supremum at most 12 sqrt(e).
After the completed diffuse O0 branch and QFORM-O0-THREE-HEAVY-CROSSBANK-CLOSURE-v1, every unpaid O0 state has at most two 3/4-heavy physical rows at the effective-dimension-three calibration.

If the live near-coloop two-row cross currency is realized in a zero-self physical two-row bank, the grouped cross-bank theorem gives a continuous density bound <28.542 C_lin^2 gamma^-1. The arbitrary-self-block/scale splice remains open.
